_note: The shed workshop (F3, look A): once the old shed is ours and the whistle is found (data/unlocks.json 'workshop'), tapping the shed on the backyard map sticks a workshop card on the map. 'pinned' drawings hang on its plank at once, in list order; they all fill at the same time and you tap 'build it!' when one is full; the next drawing from the list is pinned in its spot. A drawing needs 'need' helpers, 'count' of them at 'tier' or up. Helpers are plain pets (the ones the new homes stall may take); they stay on for good (no star). Pets below the tier only go in while there's room left for the ones that meet it. 'at' is where the built thing stands on the backyard map (map units from home, like the places' 'map'), 'size' how big it's drawn (of a 48 px sheet at the map's usual zoom). 'art' is crayon lines on a 48 x 48 sheet (SVG path bodies). 'chore' is what it takes away (for docs and tests: the rules live in GameState). 'say' is what your pet says when you pick it on the plank, 'done' when it's built. Built: bell = trips you sent welcome themselves back (not the one you're watching on the trail), their postcards wait for you; shelf = a play ends, your pet plays with the same toy for the same length again; vane = a trip waiting at a plain choice (no option risky at that place) takes your last pick for that event at that place, risky ones always wait for you; chart = every open errand has 'new pets join here'; spade = rummage spots in the room get dug through by themselves; basket = toys not being played with lose 'basket_mend_per_hour' wear an hour (wear is 0..1), also while the game is closed (up to 12 h); banner = on the trail, a treat is tossed whenever one is ready; letter = postcards wait in the letterbox until you tap it (at most 'letterbox_keep', not saved). Never a drawing (manual on purpose): the school bell, reel banking, the newest globe's lever, ripping boxes yourself, risky trip choices. Numbers are placeholders from the mockup (tune with the pace sim).
